compos.text: Alt text: "A smartphone UI displaying a human body with highlighted muscles. A vertical menu on the right lists various body systems: Brain, Eyes, Ears & Hearing, Immune System, Muscles (highlighted), Lungs & Breathing, Heart & Circulatory, Stomach, Fingers & Toes, and Skin. Each system is represented by an icon."

Alt text: "Smartphone status bar displaying various icons from left to right: Facebook icon, notification icon, Wi-Fi icon, battery icon, lock icon, calendar icon, Bluetooth icon, signal strength icon, Wi-Fi signal icon, battery percentage icon, and the time '6:16'."
The image shows a text label that reads "Body Scanner."
Alt text: "Breathe2Relax" text displayed on a smartphone UI.
Alt text: "Text displaying the word 'Muscles' with a blue gradient effect."

compos.summarization:
The given smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Breathe2Relax." The main content of this screen is a "Body Scanner" feature, which displays a human body diagram. The diagram highlights different body systems and parts, which are listed on the right side of the screen. These include:

1. Brain
2. Eyes
3. Ears & Hearing
4. Immune System
5. Muscles (currently selected)
6. Lungs & Breathing
7. Heart & Circulatory
8. Stomach
9. Fingers & Toes
10. Skin

Each body part or system has a corresponding icon next to it. The highlighted section on the body diagram changes based on the selected body part or system. The current selection is "Muscles," which is highlighted in the diagram.
